title: skilldrop packs/<pack>/pack.json
$comment: RFC-0001 / RFC-0032 / RFC-0033 / RFC-0034. One pack's metadata. Membership is not listed here: a skill is in this pack because it sits at packs/<pack>/skills/<name>/, and a loop because it sits at packs/<pack>/loops/<name>/. Key names follow agent-ready-repo's pack.toml so the two stay mechanically convertible.

description.description: One line — who this pack is for.

display_name.description: RFC-0032. Human title for the pack's page and plugin entry.

keywords.description: RFC-0032. Search terms, copied into the plugin entry.

links.description: RFC-0032. Catalogue-facing links; `documentation` is the pack's page.

first-value.description: RFC-0032. What to try first after installing, how to tell it worked, and what to do if it didn't. Key names match agent-ready-repo's [pack.first-value].

requires.description: RFC-0033. Packs installed together with this one (in practice, `core`). One level only: a required pack may not itself require.
